summary: Completed backend + frontend verification for Rakhigarhi reference page and related regressions. Public section structure/copy/images/responsive behavior and live-editor image/text editing flows are working. One requirement mismatch found: expected hash deep-links are not present in navigation/menu data.

critical.issue: Main menu data does not include /our-work/rakhigarhi#archaeology and /our-work/rakhigarhi#haveli-chaupal; only /our-work/rakhigarhi is present.

integration_issues.issue: No anchor links with #archaeology or #haveli-chaupal are rendered in current public navigation; direct hash URLs resolve, but explicit links are absent.
Observed 401 only on /api/auth/me during unauthenticated visits (expected/non-blocking).

action_items: Add/restore required hash deep-links for Rakhigarhi sections (#archaeology and #haveli-chaupal) in intended menu/navigation source.
Re-run backend pytest and UI smoke after menu deep-link fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Rakhigarhi content migration appears correctly applied and stable: 9 sections, expected anchors/order, white hero copy, approved media references, and migration marker design_migration=rakhigarhi-reference-2026-10-15.
Revision safety checks passed: pre-migration backups exist in revisions (before Rakhigarhi reference for published/draft).

LiveEditor image-path handling works for image and collage.n fields: selecting facade/detail images exposes Library/Upload controls and all 8 resize handles without turning those image targets into contentEditable text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on preview URL with owner credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public checks passed for: hero copy, required section anchors, collage image decode after scroll, responsive widths 320/390/768/1024/1440/1536/1920 (no overflow), 3-column to 1-column use grid behavior, ambition stacking <=960, Explore Craft & Livelihood link, and cross-page regressions (home/craft/workshops available; workshops dummy placeholders/film pending unchanged via existing tests). Live editor checks passed for owner on ?edit=1 with persistence across craft/home/workshops and image-field selection for facade+collage[0]+collage[1].
rca of the issue: Root cause of failing test: site menu configuration currently stores only /our-work/rakhigarhi child link and does not contain deep-link anchors for #archaeology and #haveli-chaupal. This is a content/menu data mismatch rather than routing failure, because direct hash URLs themselves resolve and target sections exist. Mitigation: update menu children or intended navigation source to include the two deep-link hrefs and keep hash fragments intact through render.
